breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the core physical impossibility. The generated specification explicitly states to use an upstream Mach number of 0.8, which is subsonic. Normal shock waves can only form in supersonic flow (Mach > 1). The ground truth corrected this by changing the Mach number to 2.0.
